name: Demo · Sentiment classifier
headline: Tiny product-review classifier on mobile-cpu
description: A pre-loaded project with 30 short product reviews labelled positive / neutral / negative, plus a 10-row gold set. Targets mobile-cpu deployment with an ONNX-INT8 export to show the full size-conscious path.
suggested_brief: Train a tiny 3-way sentiment classifier (positive / neutral / negative) on short product reviews. Target on-device mobile CPU inference. Macro-F1 above 0.75 is the bar.
